adjudication.rationale: The controller explicitly sets `response.headers['X-Frame-Options'] = "ALLOWALL"` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). `ALLOWALL` is not a standard/valid X-Frame-Options directive (standard values are e.g. `DENY`, `SAMEORIGIN`, historically `ALLOW-FROM`), so browsers may ignore it or behave inconsistently, affecting real framing behavior. The spec only asserts the literal string `"ALLOWALL"`, so it would pass even if the value is ineffective for actual browser embedding.
